text:
Imani Brooks: Hey folks! I started today as a platform engineer on the serving runtime team. Laptop arrived (M1 Mac) but hitting an issue pulling the team dev image. Quick hello — excited to join. Fun fact: I have 30+ enamel pins and name my plants. :seedling:

Karla Nguyen: welcome Imani!! People Ops here. If anything hardware/shipping related ping me DM. Also drop your t-shirt size.

Imani Brooks: Thanks Karla — M. T-shirt: womens M. 

Devon Lee: welcome! What's the error when you try to pull?

Imani Brooks: `docker pull registry.redwood.internal/serve-dev:latest` fails with "no matching manifest for linux/arm64 in the manifest list entries"

Samir Rao: ah yep that's the ARM issue. We publish amd64 images by default. For M1 you can use our multiarch tag or run under amd64 emulation. Try `docker pull registry.redwood.internal/serve-dev:multiarch` or `docker run --platform linux/amd64 ...`

Imani Brooks: tried the multiarch tag, still fails with a TLS handshake error: "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority" when using company VPN

Ayesha Khan: did you enroll in the device certs flow? People Ops should have sent a link to install the corp CA. If not ping me and I'll resend. Also workstation onboarding doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/onboarding/workstation

Karla Nguyen: re-sent cert link and Okta invite. If you see Okta error code 1020, try the one-time link from the onboarding email.

Imani Brooks: got the Okta invite but MFA setup page spins forever. Using Chrome on macOS 13.4

Devon Lee: same thing happened to me until I updated Chrome to latest. Also try disabling any adblock extensions. If that fails, try Safari.

eng-infra-bot: Reminder: request for registry group "serve-team" must be approved by team lead. Use `#eng-infra` to request temporary token.

Samir Rao: I can approve a temporary token. @Imani Brooks DM me your employee email and I'll add you to serve-team for 48h so you can pull images.

Imani Brooks: DM sent. Quick intro: previously at a small ML infra shop, like debugging kernels and build infra. Two truths & a lie: I once toured with a folk band, I can't swim, I made a typo in a conference talk slide that went viral. Which is the lie? :thinking_face:

Ayesha Khan: I'm guessing the touring one is true, typo is the lie? :thinking:

Samir Rao: I think you can swim — lie is the "can't swim".

Imani Brooks: you're right Samir — I can swim, the lie was that the typo went viral (thankfully). :sweat_smile:

Karla Nguyen: Welcome again! Sticker pack + snack box incoming. If you want a standing desk, fill the request form and we'll fast-track it.

Imani Brooks: thanks all — pulling multiarch image now while I wait for token. Appreciate the warm welcome :rocket:

People Ops Bot: @Imani Brooks added to #new-hires, onboarding checklist marked 2/6 complete.
